name: Can hydro jetting damage my pipes?

mainEntity.name: Can hydro jetting damage my pipes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hydro jetting is generally safe for most modern plumbing systems, but it can potentially damage old, corroded, or already compromised pipes. Before initiating the service, CG Plumbing Solutions often recommends a camera inspection to assess the condition of your pipes. This crucial step allows us to identify any existing weaknesses, cracks, or serious corrosion that could be exacerbated by the high-pressure water. If fragile pipes are detected, we will discuss alternative, safer solutions with you to prevent any damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hydro jetting is safe for most pipes, but can damage old or compromised ones. We typically perform a camera inspection first to identify potential risks and discuss safer alternatives if needed.
